questions.stem: Male skull can be differentiated from the female skull with the help of all given features EXCEPT:

Large parietal eminence

Parietal and frontal eminence are large in females as compared to male.

questions.stem: A 14-year-old girl comes to OPD with a fractured forearm. On asking her about the injury, she says that she fell and hit her hand. On examination, the doctor observes that there are cigarette burn marks on her forearm. What should be done next?

options.label: B
options.text: To call local social worker for help

options.label: D
options.text: Tell your colleagues that you are sure that this is a case of child abuse and take action

questions.solutionHtml:
Do a complete physical examination

The first step after suspecting a case of abuse is to do a complete detailed history taking and physical examination of the patient to see any other injuries which can confirm the findings.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 445.

questions.stem: All are true about Doctrine of Borrowed Servant except:

options.label: A
options.text: Hospital administration is responsible for the action, of interns and trainees

options.label: B
options.text: A nurse assisting a surgery is a borrowed servant of the hospital

options.label: C
options.text: Doctor assisting a surgeon for fee in OT

options.label: D
options.text: Physician is responsible for the acts done according to his orders by other staffs

questions.answerText: Doctor assisting a surgeon for fee in OT
questions.solutionHtml:
Doctor assisting a surgeon for fee in OT

When two doctors practice as partners, each is liable for negligence of the other, even though he may have no part in the negligent act.

questions.stemHtml: A 14-year-old female was claimed to be kidnapped. On interrogation, she claims that she is not a minor and left home with the person of her own will. Court ordered for her age estimation. Given below are the X-rays of pelvis, wrist, and bilateral elbow. What is her most probable age based on these ?
questions.solutionHtml:
21–22 years
  • In figure 1, all the ossification centers are fused around the elbow, so the age must be ≥ 16 years.
  • In figure 2, the lower end of radius and ulna are fused, so the age must be at least 18 years.
  • In figure 3, Ischial tuberosity is fused, so the age must be around 20–21 years.
  • So the best answer for this question would be option (D) 21–22 years.


KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 80.

questions.stem: Calculate the age of the fetus having CRL 23 cm, foot length 8 cm. Talus is present and testes are present at superficial inguinal rings?
questions.solutionHtml:
7 months

Fetus having CRL 23 cm, Talus is present ,testes are present in superficial inguinal rings Which are seen at 7 mth of Intrauterine gestation.

questions.stem: Which among the following is the alkaloid synthesized during cell metabolism of living cells?
questions.solutionHtml:
Leucomaine
  • Leucomaine is an animal alkaloid which appears in tissues during life .
  • while ptomaine is a cadaveric alkaloid.
